1.overview: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the Thessalonian church and thank God for its growing faith, love, and perseverance amid persecution. Paul describes God’s judgment at Jesus’ revelation, when the afflicted receive relief, their persecutors face destruction, and Jesus is glorified in believers, then records a prayer for their calling and faithful work.

2.overview: Paul rejects reports that the Day of the Lord has already come, describing the rebellion, the revealing and eventual destruction of the lawless one, and the deception accompanying his coming. He thanks God for the Thessalonians’ calling to salvation and glory, urges them to stand firm in the teachings they received, and prays that God and Christ will strengthen them.

sections.heading: The Day of the Lord and the Lawless One

3.overview: Paul asks the Thessalonians to pray for the spread of the Lord’s word and for his deliverance, and expresses confidence that the Lord will strengthen and guide them. He instructs them to distance themselves from undisciplined believers who refuse to work while admonishing them as brothers, then gives a blessing of peace and identifies his handwritten greeting.

sections.heading: Prayer and confidence in the Lord
